voice.wake_word.description: Empty follows 嘿 + Agent name / 留空跟随 Agent 名

voice.wake_enabled.description: Background listening is opt-in / 后台监听须主动启用

voice.asr.mode.description: Local audio stays on host; cloud sends to your provider / 云端会把语音发给所选服务商

voice.asr.engine.description: Local ASR implementation / 本地识别引擎

voice.asr.provider.description: Cloud provider with your own local key / 使用自己的本机 key

voice.asr.model.description: Provider model ID; choose one with audio input / 服务商支持音频输入的模型 ID

voice.asr.key_env.description: Environment variable NAME only; never paste a key / 仅变量名，勿填密钥

voice.tts.mode.description: Phone local voices, host OS speech, or your cloud provider / 手机本地、主机或云端

voice.tts.voice.description: Host OS or cloud provider voice ID / 主机系统或云端服务商音色 ID

voice.tts.provider.description: Own-key provider; reply audio crosses our relay only as ciphertext / 自有密钥服务商；回复音频只以密文经过中继

voice.tts.model.description: Cloud speech model / 云端语音模型

voice.tts.key_env.description: Environment variable NAME only / 仅环境变量名

voice.speak_replies.description: Automatically read completed replies / 自动朗读完成的回复

voice.speak_notifications.description: Read generic notifications (no locked-screen content) / 播报通用提醒

appearance.language.description: Your language: phone screens, account emails and the language Agent J speaks with you / 你的语言：手机界面、账号邮件，以及 Agent J 和你交流用的语言

menu.items.description: Menu entries: id, cmd, desc, group, order; inserts text only / 菜单只插文字

keyboard.bindings.description: Key entries: id, combo, action; allowed actions only / 快捷键只引用允许动作

channels.items.description: Optional channels; Telegram sends content to Telegram / 可选通道；Telegram 可读通道内容

approval.timeout.description: May only shorten approval lifetime / 只可缩短审批有效期

approval.jev_threshold.description: Jev layer 2: allow a can't-tell command without a card when Jev's p ≥ this (only with OPENROUTER_API_KEY; the five danger categories always ask) / Jev 第二层：看不清的命令 Jev 概率 ≥ 此值时免弹卡（需 OPENROUTER_API_KEY；五类明确危险一律弹卡）

approval.goal_auto.description: Goal mode (/goal): outside the signed grant, an action the computer can undo (git-tracked, trash, a push to a known remote) asks with a 10-second countdown and is approved when nobody answers; off = an ordinary card that never approves by itself / 目标模式：授权范围外、Agent J 主机能撤回的动作弹 10 秒倒计时卡，无人点即批准；关掉 = 普通卡，不会自动批准

approval.level.description: Approval level: safe asks more (no Jev, no batch, no goal countdown); standard = as before; full = like --dangerously-skip-permissions, almost no cards, but a suspected attack, credentials and payments still ask. Changed only by a signed phone confirmation / 审批档位：安全多问、中等（默认，同以前）、全放行（几乎不弹卡，疑似攻击、凭据、花钱仍问）；只能在已配对手机上签名切换

approval.goal_nocard.description: Goal mode without the opening card: a /goal starts at once and its steps run without cards, except a suspected attack, credentials and payments. Counts only while the phone that switched it on stays paired / 设了目标就不弹窗：/goal 不再弹开工卡，目标里的步骤不弹卡（疑似攻击、凭据、花钱仍问）；只认打开它的那台已配对手机

security.e2e.description: End-to-end encryption cannot be disabled / 端到端加密不可关闭

security.signed_approvals.description: Paired signature required / 必须已配对签名

security.danger_categories.description: All five dangerous categories always need separate approval / 危险五类单独批准

human.devices.description: Use the existing human-authorized command / 使用现有人类授权命令

human.danger_extra.description: Legacy pointer, no effect: extra warnings are agent.high_risk_warnings / 旧指针，无作用：额外提醒见 agent.high_risk_warnings

human.remote_unbind.description: Use the existing human-authorized command / 使用现有人类授权命令

human.report_hostname.description: Legacy pointer, no effect: use agentj report / 旧指针，无作用：用 agentj report

human.relay.description: Use the existing human-authorized command / 使用现有人类授权命令

human.web.description: Use the existing human-authorized command / 使用现有人类授权命令

human.fence.description: Legacy pointer, no effect: isolation is agent.isolation / 旧指针，无作用：隔离见 agent.isolation

voice.wake_pronunciation.description: Optional model phonemes for an unknown name / 生僻名字的模型音素

voice.wake_threshold.description: Offline KWS acceptance threshold; lower may cause false wakes / 离线唤醒阈值，低值更容易误唤醒

agent.working_root.description: Work root; new workflows are direct child folders / 工作根目录；新工作流建一层子目录

agent.instructions.description: Append personal instructions; constitutional core wins conflicts / 追加个人指令；冲突时核心角色优先

agent.private_instructions_file.description: Local owner instructions file appended after the core; read-only text, grants no permission / 主人本机私有指令文件，追加在核心之后；只读文字，不授予任何权限

agent.shared_identity.description: Shared Claude reads the packaged identity and private instructions via native hooks / 共享 Claude 经原生 hook 读入随包身份与私有指令

agent.session_mode.description: independent = Agent J's own fenced session (default); shared = attach to the session you have open in your terminal (advanced) / 默认独立会话；shared = 接入你正在用的终端会话（高级）

agent.shared_session_id.description: Exact existing Claude/OpenCode session ID / Agent J 主机现有会话 ID

agent.shared_opencode_port.description: Existing OpenCode loopback server port / 现有 OpenCode 回环端口

agent.high_risk_warnings.description: Optional extra warnings, off by default / 可选额外提醒，默认关闭

agent.approvals.description: Shared-mode approvals: standard asks for spending, sending out, public deletion and a credential changed or shown on screen; strict also asks when a credential is only read or mentioned; native adds no Agent J card (the harness's own permissions only) / 共享模式审批：standard 花钱、对外发送、公开删除、改凭据或把凭据显示到屏幕时弹；strict 只要读到或提到凭据也弹；native 不另外弹卡，只看 harness 自己的权限

updates.mode.description: 自动升级并通知主人，或先询问；紧急安全修复会立即升级。 Upgrade automatically and tell the owner, or ask first. Urgent security fixes upgrade immediately.

updates.skill_categories.description: 本机推荐技能分类：内容创作、App 开发、电商、通用。 Locally relevant skill categories: content, app, commerce, general.

telegram.groups.description: Group profiles and numeric sender allowlists / 群配置与发送人白名单

telegram.private_domains.description: Your domains, hidden from Telegram group replies (e-mails always are) / 发往群的回复隐去这些域名（邮箱一律隐去）

telegram.forward.description: Share button forwards to your Telegram private chat / 分享按钮一点转发到你的 Telegram 私聊

telegram.owner_commands.description: Private-chat commands answered by your local program, never the model / 私聊命令由你本机程序回答，不经模型

proxy.https_env.description: Variable NAME passed as HTTPS_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY 的来源变量名

proxy.http_env.description: Variable NAME passed as HTTP_PROXY / HTTP_PROXY 的来源变量名

proxy.no_proxy_env.description: Variable NAME passed as NO_PROXY / NO_PROXY 的来源变量名

proxy.https.description: HTTPS_PROXY for the Agent's harness only, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890; no user:password@ (use proxy.https_env) / 只给 Agent 子进程的 HTTPS 代理，例如 http://127.0.0.1:7890；不写账号密码

proxy.http.description: HTTP_PROXY for the Agent's harness only; empty follows proxy.https / 只给 Agent 子进程的 HTTP 代理；留空跟随 HTTPS 代理

proxy.no_proxy.description: NO_PROXY for the Agent's harness, comma-separated hosts; empty with a proxy set bypasses localhost / 不走代理的主机，逗号分隔；留空时本机地址自动绕过

voice.tts.command.description: Local speech argv; UTF-8 text on stdin, write PCM WAV to {output}; no secrets / 本地发声参数；stdin 收文字，{output} 写 WAV，勿填密钥

voice.tts.command_timeout.description: Local speech deadline in seconds / 本地发声超时秒数

agent.isolation.description: Independent sessions run in the fence (data hidden); off = the harness's own permissions / 独立会话在隔离里运行（隐藏数据）；关闭则按底层 harness 自己的权限

agent.allow_docker.description: Let the fenced Agent use docker / podman, off by default / 让隔离中的 Agent 使用 docker / podman，默认关闭

updates.auto_install.description: Nightly host upgrades in the local 03:00–05:00 window; skip busy hosts / 夜间闲置自动升级. P203: also the first fully idle moment after the daily check saw a newer version (once a day); the phone's 「空闲时自动更新」 switch sets this and updates.mode together / 空闲时自动更新

updates.report_failures.description: When an upgrade fails, send the failed step, the reason and the installer's last lines (redacted on this computer: keys, tokens, paths, names) with the redacted doctor output to Agent J support, once per version and reason a day; off sends nothing / 升级失败时自动把失败步骤、原因和安装命令最后几行（本机先脱敏）连同脱敏后的自检结果发给 Agent J 客服；关闭则不发

browser.enabled.description: Agent J's own browser for sign-ins and web automation; off keeps the profile / Agent J 专用浏览器（登录与网页自动化）；关闭会保留登录资料

browser.download_source.description: Where the browser is downloaded: official first, then a same-bytes mirror / 浏览器下载源：先官方，再同字节镜像

browser.mirror.description: Your own HTTPS mirror base; bytes must match the signed manifest / 自有 HTTPS 镜像地址；文件须与签名清单逐字节一致
browser.mirror.patternHint: an https:// mirror base URL, or empty

browser.check_time.description: Daily read-only sign-in check, local time; never sends QR codes / 每日只读登录体检时间（本地时间），不会推送二维码

voice.tts.phone_voice.description: Phone local voice name or URI; empty uses the language default / 手机本机音色名称或 URI；空值使用同语言默认音色

background_done.enabled.description: Report background job completions / 后台活结束时唤醒主 Agent 汇报

heartbeat.enabled.description: Wake the main Agent after an idle spell to check background work and to-dos (one model call each) / 空闲一段时间后自动醒来检查后台和待办（每次消耗一次模型调用）

heartbeat.interval_minutes.description: Idle minutes before a heartbeat, 5–1440 (agentj heartbeat set 30m) / 空闲多少分钟心跳一次，5–1440

owner.address.description: How Agent J addresses you, text only, ≤ 16 characters; empty = 董事长 / Chairman (the phone's working line uses it) / 对你的称呼，纯文字，最多 16 个字；留空即「董事长」

heartbeat.daily_at.description: Also wake once a day at this local time, HH:MM (24-hour); empty = off (agentj heartbeat daily 07:30) / 每天固定时间唤醒一次（本地时间 HH:MM，24 小时制），留空关闭

quota.reminders.description: Quota steward: the heartbeat and morning brief remind you when a harness's weekly quota is going to waste or an extra reset is about to expire, at most once a day per kind (agentj quota off) / 额度管家：周额度要浪费、额外 reset 快过期时，心跳和晨报提醒你，同类每天最多一次

quota.auto_switch.description: When the current AI account's 5-hour quota passes 80 % or its weekly quota 90 %, newly starting scheduled tasks / workflows go to another signed-in AI account that still has room and answers a handshake, without asking; off = the phone asks first. The main conversation never moves; a task.json naming its harness is kept / 额度告警时把新任务交给其他 AI 账号（不问）；关=先在手机上问

ui.card_hot_action.description: The reply card's bottom-left hot key: which command or skill it runs (default web-page-report; e.g. status, compact, clear, or any skill name) / 回复卡左下角快捷技能键绑定的命令或技能（默认 web-page-report，可换成 status、compact、clear 或任意技能名）
ui.card_hot_action.patternHint: a command or skill name like web-page-report, status or compact (a leading / is fine)

ui.composer_buttons.description: The order (left to right) of the four buttons above the phone's message box: file, image, camera, mic — each exactly once / 手机输入框上方四个按钮从左到右的顺序（file 文件、image 图片、camera 拍照、mic 麦克风，各一次）

imessage.enabled.description: macOS only: read new iMessage / SMS on this Mac (read-only, needs Full Disk Access) and send the important ones to your paired phone / 仅 macOS：只读这台 Mac 上新的 iMessage / 短信（需要完全磁盘访问权限），把重要的推到配对手机

imessage.interval_minutes.description: How often to look for new messages, 1–1440 minutes (codes: 1–5 is best) / 多久看一次新消息，1–1440 分钟（要及时收验证码建议 1–5）

imessage.delivery.description: instant = every kept message at once; instant_digest = important at once, the rest in the digest; digest = only codes and VIPs at once / 提醒方式：全部即时 / 重要即时 + 其余进摘要 / 只要摘要（验证码与重要联系人仍即时）

imessage.digest_at.description: Digest times, local HH:MM, comma-separated, up to 4; empty = no digest / 摘要时间（本地 HH:MM，逗号分隔，最多 4 个），留空不发摘要

imessage.quiet_hours.description: Quiet hours HH:MM-HH:MM: alerts wait for the digest (codes and VIPs still come); empty = off / 免打扰时段 HH:MM-HH:MM：期间提醒攒进摘要（验证码与重要联系人照常），留空关闭

imessage.strictness.description: Filter: loose = block only clear spam; standard; strict = only codes, VIPs and clear notices / 过滤强度：宽松（只挡确定的垃圾）/ 标准 / 严格（只提醒验证码、重要联系人和明确通知）

imessage.codes.description: Verification codes: show (hidden from the history after 30 minutes), mask (source only) or off / 验证码：显示（30 分钟后从历史里隐去）/ 打码（只显示来源）/ 不提醒

imessage.groups.description: Include group chats (digest only) / 包含群聊（只进摘要）

imessage.llm.description: Second layer for undecided messages: off = local rules only (nothing leaves this Mac); redacted = Jev sees a redacted copy (numbers, e-mails, links removed; never codes) / 第二层智能分类：关（只用本地规则，正文不出本机）/ 脱敏后交 Jev 判断（去掉号码、邮箱、链接，验证码永不外发）

imessage.vip.description: VIP numbers / e-mails: always alerted, matched exactly (never by name) / 重要联系人号码或邮箱：一律提醒，严格按号码匹配，不按姓名

imessage.mute.description: Muted numbers / e-mails / keywords: never alerted / 静音的号码、邮箱或关键词：永不提醒

imessage.instructions.description: Your filtering and alert rules in your own words (read-only on the phone; ask Agent J to change it: agentj imessage instructions set) / 用你自己的话写的过滤与提醒规则（手机上只读；要改就让 Agent J 用 agentj imessage instructions set 改）

api_keys.extra_env_files.description: Extra .env files the Models & API keys page scans for keys you already have (names + last 4 only; up to 8 absolute or ~/ paths; none by default) / 「模型和 API Key」页额外扫描的 .env 文件（只读名字和后 4 位；最多 8 个绝对路径或 ~/ 路径；默认无）

notify.enabled.description: Let your own automations (scripts, timers) post messages and files to the phone with `agentj notify`; each one still needs its own switch / 允许你自己的自动化（脚本、定时器）用 agentj notify 往手机发消息和文件；每个自动化仍要单独打开

notify.automations.description: Each automation's switch: [{"id": "<the --from name>", "allow": true|false}]; not listed = refused. Agent J tasks use id task.<task id> / 每个自动化的开关（id = --from 的名字）；没登记的一律拒绝。Agent J 定时任务用 task.<任务 id>

jev.mode.description: Jev safety route; empty prompts setup; off requires signed owner confirmation / Jev 审核来源；关闭须主人签名

skills.stale_days.description: Days without use before the Skills page says a skill is long unused, 7–365 (never archived by itself) / 多少天没用就在技能页标「很久没用了」，7–365（不会自动归档）

skills.suggest.description: After the same task 3 times in 14 days, the Agent offers once to save it as a skill / 同类事 14 天内做满 3 次，Agent 主动问一次要不要存成技能
